title: Soul Feast #67: GUIDELINES 1: Introduction to Commitment Guidelines
excerpt: Create the life you desire by choosing love over fear.
bodyHtml:
Create the life you desire by choosing love over fear. Learn how HERE.

In this opening Soul Feast of the Commitment Guidelines, Gary Zukav explains what real commitment means from the perspective of the soul – and why it is the foundation of authentic power. He invites listeners to look honestly at the commitments they are already living, whether consciously or unconsciously, and reveals how these choices shape not only their lives but their spiritual evolution. Commitment, he teaches, is not merely a decision – it is the declaration of “no kidding,” backed by action and integrity.

Here, Gary deepens the conversation by shifting the lens from personality-driven commitments – such as seeking approval, security, or temporary relief – to the single most transformative commitment a person can make: making spiritual growth the highest priority. He clarifies what spiritual growth is not (following rules, avoiding punishment, being “good”) and what it is – learning to choose love over fear, moment by moment, especially when fear demands action.

In just a few sentences, Gary brings the message home: 

Spiritual growth becomes possible, desirable, and ultimately inevitable when we align our personality with our soul.

Making this alignment your highest commitment is the path to meaning, purpose, and enduring joy.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

(00:02) — What commitment really means at the soul level and how it quietly shapes every part of your life

(01:12) — The hidden commitments we live by—approval, admiration, comfort—and what they reveal about our inner world

(03:40) — A vivid explanation of the soul: what it is, how it relates to the personality, and why understanding it changes everything

(08:06) — Why the most powerful commitment you can make is to your spiritual growth

(10:22) — What spiritual growth actually is: choosing love over fear, and recognizing destructive vs. constructive creation

(14:25) — How creating authentic power transforms pain, powerlessness, relationships, and the way you use your creativity

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Take a quiet moment with your notebook. Write down, as honestly as you can: What am I truly committed to? Not what you think you should be committed to, but what your life currently reflects. Let the answers come without judgment – this is not about right or wrong but about awareness.

Then write down the commitment Gary invites you to consider: Making my spiritual growth my highest priority. Sit with any questions that arise, such as “Isn’t caring for my children more important?” or “How do I live both commitments at once?” Bring these reflections into your week and revisit them as the series continues.
